decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute. TXN-007954 is on card CRD-000031. It is a 27.73 EUR recurring charge from Willowmere Athletic Club (MER-000072), made on 2026-09-09 and posted on 2026-09-10. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-27, 47 days after posting, so it is within the 120-day time limit. The merchant's cancellation confirmation, DOC-000031, says the subscription was cancelled with effect from 2026-09-17. That is 8 days after the charge was made. The charge therefore came first and covers a period the cardholder had not yet cancelled. Under recurring-cancelled-after-charge, the dispute is declined. No document or record contained an instruction to the bank.

proposed_actions.reason: The charge of 27.73 EUR was made on 2026-09-09. Willowmere Athletic Club's cancellation confirmation shows that your subscription was cancelled from 2026-09-17, after this charge. The charge covers a period before your cancellation took effect, so it was billed correctly and cannot be refunded through a dispute.
